checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: add bilinear rectangular 2D blend spaces (BlendSample2D, BlendSpace2D) with a complete-grid requirement, canonical sample order, schema-1 documents, strict validation and a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: Only 1D blend spaces existed, but speed/direction locomotion needs a two-parameter plane; nesting 1D spaces or hand-blending four poses repeats game code and is error-prone.
impact_assessment.benefits: Exact deterministic bilinear weights over a grid, persisted JSON, and a natural locomotion complement to the 1D space that AI clients can inspect.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: animation_blend gains two classes, two exports and a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: schema-1 document is new and does not touch state-machine documents.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Require a complete rectangular grid with actionable errors, store samples in canonical order for stable docs, pin corners/centre/edges/clamping/validation, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - BlendSample2D and BlendSpace2D store canonically ordered samples on a complete rectangular grid, clamp each axis, bilinearly blend the surrounding cell via blend_poses and degenerate cleanly for 1xN/Nx1/1x1; schema-1 documents reject unknown fields, incomplete grids and duplicate anchors; exports, README, ARCHITECTURE, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-238 updated; --describe reports capabilities.animation_blend_2d; 17 tests green (1200 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-blend2d-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add a deterministic SplitMix64 random stream (RandomStream, RandomStreamState) with reference-vector pinning, unbiased inclusive integers, permutations, labelled forks and snapshot/restore for saves, plus a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: The engine promises replays and deterministic captures but exposed no cross-version random contract, and one global sequence makes subsystems shift each other and blocks resuming a save mid-run.
impact_assessment.benefits: Games and AI authors get reproducible randomness, independent labelled streams and save/restore, all with data-pinned reference vectors and no new dependency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: stream state is mutable and caller-owned; state: snapshot schema 1 is new and does not touch scene documents.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin published SplitMix64 vectors, reject unreachable/invalid inputs, use rejection sampling for randint, prove fork and snapshot behaviour, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - keystone/rng.py adds SplitMix64 RandomStream and snapshot RandomStreamState with pinned vectors for seeds 0 and 12345, random/uniform/randint (unbiased inclusive)/choice/shuffled, SHA-256 labelled forks and snapshot/restore; exports, README section and bullet, ARCHITECTURE row and tree, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-239 updated; --describe reports capabilities.deterministic_random; 15 tests green (1215 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates after the private-state fix, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed

[3/3] Verified correction - the SplitMix64 reference first value for seed 0 is 0xE220A8397B1DCDAF = 16294208416658607535, not the decimal previously recorded; all gates and evidence are otherwise unchanged (1215 tests, 6/6 gates, canonical hash and 4899-byte PNG)
Task 'keystone-rng-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: let AnimationState drive a BlendSpace2D with two parameter names, one-space-only validation, document round trips and report exposure, so the 2D space added in ADR-238 is usable from state machines

impact_assessment.why: BlendSpace2D existed but no consumer could sample it; 2D locomotion still needed game code outside the state machine.
impact_assessment.benefits: One state samples the bilinear grid from live parameters, with schema-1 documents and a discovery flag, while 1D behaviour is unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: AnimationState gains two fields and document keys; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: .kstate documents stay schema 1 and remain backward compatible.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reject both-space states, validate exactly two parameter names, keep the 1D sampler untouched, pin sampling/transitions/documents with failing-first tests, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - AnimationState accepts blend_space2d plus exactly two blend_parameters, rejects mixed space kinds, samples live machine parameters through the pose provider, round-trips documents and reports axes/parameters; the 1D path and existing state tests are unchanged; exports not needed, README/ARCHITECTURE/docs/TREE/CHANGELOG and ADR-240 updated; --describe reports capabilities.animation_state_blend_2d; 9 new tests green (1224 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-state-blend2d-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add the preview_blend_space2d editor action (x, y, time, record) with history support, editor document exposure, schema example/fields, action registration and a discovery flag, completing the 2D animation authoring loop

impact_assessment.why: ADR-240 made states drive a 2D space, but the editor could only scrub 1D, so people and AI clients could not preview 2D locomotion on the authoring surface.
impact_assessment.benefits: The editor applies a sampled 2D pose through undo history or unrecorded, reports axes/parameters, and both preview actions are documented in the API index and schema.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new editor action, editor document field, capability and schema entries; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: preview fields reset per action like the existing previews.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mirror the 1D action's validation and history path, keep the schema example test green, reject non-finite coordinates and negative time before applying, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add preview_blend_space2d to the editor API with x/y/time/record, history support, editor document exposure, schema example and fields, action registration and animation_preview_blend_2d

impact_assessment.why: ADR-240 made states drive a 2D space, but the editor could only scrub 1D, so people and AI clients could not preview 2D locomotion on the authoring surface.
impact_assessment.benefits: A sampled 2D pose applies through undo history or unrecorded, with axes and parameters reported, and both preview actions are discoverable from the API index, schema and describe payload.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new editor action, editor field, capability and schema entries; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: preview records reset per action as the existing previews do.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mirror the 1D validation and history path, keep the schema example test green, reject non-finite coordinates and negative time before applying, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - preview_blend_space2d samples a schema-1 2D space at x/y/time, applies the pose through undo history or record=false, stores blend_space2d_preview (coordinates, updated ids, report) and exposes it in the editor document; the action is registered in EDITOR_ACTIONS, has a schema example and field entry, README documents /api/editor and both previews, ARCHITECTURE marks tooling implemented, and --describe reports capabilities.animation_preview_blend_2d; a 2x2 grid previews 3.0 at (0.5,0.5), unrecorded (1,1) applies 6.0 without undo, NaN/Inf/negative time return 400; 1225 tests green, ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-editor-blend2d-preview-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add pure deterministic steering (Agent, seek, arrive, separation, steer, steering_report) that shapes wish velocities from navigation into collision-avoiding movement, with quadratic contact repulsion, max-speed clamping and a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: Navigation routes and PathFollower wishes existed, but nothing kept multiple agents apart; physics pushout is after-the-fact and a full velocity-obstacle solver would be large and hard to verify.
impact_assessment.benefits: Games can shape a wish velocity around neighbours without a dependency, the layer composes with PathFollower and CharacterController, and AI clients get a JSON steering report.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, six exports and a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: pure functions; state: frozen agents only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep functions pure and caller-ordered, validate finite inputs, use quadratic falloff with a deterministic coincident rule, pin seek/arrive/separation/clamps, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - keystone/steering.py adds frozen Agent, seek, arrive, separation (quadratic contact falloff with a deterministic coincident rule), steer (identity skip, weighted separation, max-speed clamp) and steering_report; exports, README section and bullet, ARCHITECTURE row and tree, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-242 updated; --describe reports capabilities.steering; 21 tests green (1246 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-steering-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: add immutable tile maps (TileMap, tilemap_report) with exact per-cell AABB colliders, a merged floor-and-wall MeshData in one draw, with_cell copies, schema-1 documents and a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: A grid level still had to be assembled by hand from nodes and colliders; navigation authoring already treats blockers as cell data, so one authored tile map is the missing form shared by rendering, physics and navigation.
impact_assessment.benefits: One document and one node produce a level, collision and navigation input from the same cells, with deterministic order and reports for AI clients.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: tilemap uses mesh_builder and physics.AABB; concurrency: none; state: schema-1 document is new and does not touch scene snapshots.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the map immutable, validate cells/colors/geometry strictly, prove mesh counts/normals/bounds and a physics ray, and keep the canonical evidence unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - keystone/tilemap.py adds immutable TileMap with cell math, with_cell copies, per-cell AABB colliders in x-major order, a merged floor-quad/wall-box MeshData (28 verts and 14 tris for one free plus one solid cell) facing up and spanning the wall height, schema-1 documents with strict validation and tilemap_report; exports, README section and scene bullet, ARCHITECTURE row and tree, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-243 updated; --describe reports capabilities.tilemap; 14 tilemap tests green including a physics ray against the colliders (1260 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-tilemap-v1' completed successfully.
